description: Snap. Price. Sell. Turn phone photos into Vinted listings with AI: sorted into items, cleaned, written, priced and posted with one tap. Free, for iPhone and iPad. A Scriptable app.

install.kept: Your items, photos and settings are kept.
install.firstRun: Sign in to Vinted when Vintly asks, then add a Claude or OpenAI key in Settings › AI settings for listings written from your photos.
